I have delivered real systems to municipal public-sector teams and private clients, from requirements through deployment and documentation.

exp.lota.b1: Built SIGESPU, a geospatial public-safety information system (Flutter, Dart/Shelf, PostgreSQL + PostGIS, Redis).
exp.lota.b2: Municipal Logbook: shift logging by geofence, vehicle log and PDF reports.
exp.lota.b3: Delivered with technical documentation and a cost analysis against ArcGIS, QGIS and Google Maps.
exp.lota.b4: Designed the CCTV network in Cisco Packet Tracer for a government funding application and configured IP cameras (VIVOTEK VAST2, Hikvision iVMS-4200).
exp.freelance.b1: Bilingual booking site for a tourist transport company: fare calculator, booking form, Webpay Plus payments and transactional email.
exp.freelance.b2: Full client cycle: requirements, DNS on Cloudflare, deployment and handoff.
